content: Refresh token rotation race: concurrent requests both present same single-use token; loser gets invalid_grant, and reuse-detection providers (Okta/Auth0) revoke the whole token family since a race looks identical to a replay attack. Fix: token consume+rotate must be single atomic transaction (e.g. Redis GETDEL), or add short grace window (10-30s) per OAuth 2.0 Security BCP where a already-consumed token presented within grace returns same successor instead of revoking family.
